title: LEADSCON 2025- OKC | SANDEE PAYNE KEYNOTE
description: The 1st Annual Leads Con is a real estate conference exclusively built to teach you to generate leads in 6 different ways hosted by Curtis Kupfersmith & Geoff Long. The health of any real estate business is determined by the amount of leads you as a Realtor can generate on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis. This very tactical event will teach you how to do each lead generation method from start to finish as well as demonstrate how to do them. Each topic will be 1 hour long allowing plenty of time to go into enough detail to give you all the tools you need to start using each lead generation method. The goal is to teach you how to start generating your own leads the next day after the conference in whichever lead generation method you choose to do. You will hear from people in and out of Oklahoma who are thriving in their business and willing to share how they generate leads within their own businesses.
